accepted_boundary: The root README and active plan uniquely recover v2.1 and its exact frozen design identity.
v1 and the premature v2 implementation remain historical unaccepted prototypes.
J1 and J2 verdicts cannot propagate, compensate or aggregate.
The only recovered action is fresh design review; no implementation, model, query, C8 or Shadow run is authorized.

major_finding.minimal_reproduction: For J2-E3, an adapter can emit the task-enumerated contradictory combination target_support=SUPPORTED and relation_to_target=OFF_LANE while also emitting the task-mandated EXACT_CONTEXT_CONFORMANCE_PASS. The oracle disagrees, but the design does not require oracle mismatch to derive a closed failure.
adjacent_same_root_gaps: The adapter-visible exact input bundle and oracle isolation are not frozen; the no-gold rule is natural language only.
Manifest member paths do not declare their resolution base, and the evaluator contract does not pin the manifest SHA.
minimal_remediation: Remove the adapter-authored verdict or mark it non-authoritative and ignored.

Freeze an evaluator-owned PASS-if-and-only-if exact dependency, output, oracle and authority equality rule; every other parse, key, type, hash, member, row, value, authority or exception case derives FAIL_CLOSED.
Pin each exact manifest SHA and declare base-root and path semantics.
Expose only TASK and fixture to the adapter; keep oracle outside the adapter-readable materialized bundle, with isolation verified in the implementation review.
Produce separate J1 and J2 evaluator results with no aggregate, compensation or propagation.

closed_predecessor_findings: Each J1 and J2 record now has one complete frozen oracle row.
The frozen gold combinations are internally consistent.
EXACT_CONTEXT_CONFORMANCE and source_interpretation=NOT_TESTED close the prior construct overclaim.
No v2.1 verifier, tests or run bytes exist.
